unsupported_claims: The answer says it cannot confirm the 3% Flickr figure, but the evidence states that DeepWalk's Micro-F1 with 3% of the graph labeled beats all other methods even when they have 10% of the data. This hedge is mildly inaccurate, though it is not an attribution to the paper.
rationale: The answer correctly rejects the false premise and says SpectralClustering was a baseline alongside EdgeCluster, Modularity and wvRN. Its description of DeepWalk (truncated random walks, skip-gram, logistic regression) is standard background and consistent with the evidence. The only weakness is the unneeded hedge about the 3% figure, which does not misattribute anything to the papers.
